verdict.rationale: LibreChat's docs recommend Docker Compose as the main install path, also offer npm and Helm, and say a Quick Start takes about five minutes with Docker and serves the app at localhost:3080 on Windows, macOS, or Linux. A community user independently found the install quite easy and said it works well. missing for 10: the literal single install command is not quoted in the evidence, and there is no documented confirmation that a chat works without first configuring API keys or a provider.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I can install the assistant on my own machine with one documented command — installer script, npm/pip package, or Docker image — and reach a working chat in minutes

citations.quote: For most scenarios, Docker Compose is the recommended installation method due to its simplicity, ease of use, and reliability.
For an instance of your own, install LibreChat with the Quick Start (about five minutes with Docker)
Docker and npm run it on your own machine on Windows, macOS, or Linux and serve it at http://localhost:3080
Install LibreChat yourself with Docker, npm, or a Helm chart.
